summary: Target-only chart commits are integrated and static checks pass, but CODE acceptance is incomplete; app/chart wiring and required LLM Proxy safety coverage need another bounded CODE pass.
validation: helm lint and helm template passed for workspace-context.
workspace-context/tests/static.sh passed, including storage, gates, checksum/manifest, and no-Longhorn checks.
helm lint and default helm template passed for llm-proxy; default render has no Deployment or Job and no rendered Longhorn reference.
Repository unittest passed: 5 tests; Python compilation passed.
Application YAML, explicit Kubernetes destination, and no automated Argo sync checks passed.
git diff --check passed for produced commits; protected worker/bridge files and graphify-out were absent from implementation commits.
kubeconform, kubeval, and conftest are unavailable in the environment; no cluster or Argo validation was run.
blockers: apps/workspace-context.yaml uses className/accessMode/nas keys rather than the chart's storageClassName/accessModes/storage.graphArtifacts.nfs keys, so its effective Argo override does not explicitly wire the approved NAS layout.

apps/llm-proxy.yaml contains abstract unused gates/identity fields including sourceNamespace/sourceSecretName and does not match the chart's targetGates and nested llm-proxy value paths; application-level safety and identity overrides are therefore not trustworthy.
The committed LLM Proxy chart has no 70% warning/85% critical PrometheusRule for its local-path PostgreSQL claim; only Workspace Context storage alerts are present.
The committed LLM Proxy backup scratch remains local-path rather than the approved temporary/NFS scratch path, and its worker static guard was ignored by *.sh and is absent from the commit.

Workspace Context evidence tooling references /scratch and /graph-artifacts but the committed gated job does not mount the configured scratch/artifact PVCs, so the consistency bundle is not executable when enabled.
next_action: Route back to CODE to align Argo values with chart schemas, add the missing LLM Proxy storage/NFS safety coverage and committed static guard, wire the Workspace Context consistency volumes, then rerun static validation; do not sync or deploy.
